terra.problem: The passage does not say everybody could see Jesus or that nobody had to squeeze.
Nobody having to climb anything is an added detail.
The passage does not say the seed was noticed fast.
Quick scorched adds a time interval the passage does not give.
The passage does not describe the sprout as big or green.
The passage does not say the farmer gets news about the crop.
The closing observation that the word given is worth noticing does not explain what is worth noticing, leaving the explanation generic.
Jesus says whoever has will be given more and have an abundance, not that what he has will be doubled.
The passage does not say the people's eyes and ears are working fine; the prophecy says they hardly hear and have closed their eyes.
Nobody is waiting goes beyond what Jesus says about the disciples seeing and hearing.
Before it can settle in adds a sequence the passage does not give. Jesus says what was sown in the heart is snatched away.
The final two sentences merely repeat the answer, leaving the explanation flat.
The last two sentences repeat the wording and answer without adding a meaningful explanation or Papa Dorin's personality.
The final sentence changes the deceitfulness of wealth to wealth itself, omitting a distinction Jesus makes.
Saying understanding sets the good soil apart from all the others goes beyond the text. Jesus does not say whether the people represented by rocky ground or thorns understand.
